source_kind: derived governed record-level registry over policy-controlled source releases
ownership: Every assertion, identifier, relationship, address, and coverage fact remains governed by its named upstream source and policy; this publisher owns only the registry transformation and contract.
prohibited_use: representing source-preserving profiles as a complete or deduplicated census of active U.S. businesses
representing source-specific status as universal current operating status
discarding upstream provenance, observation dates, or policy restrictions
joining ZIP5 and ZIP+4 into one canonical field
public export before every contributing source policy and quality gate authorizes it
attribution: Retain every contributing dataset ID, release ID, record identifier, source policy, manifest SHA-256 digest, transformation version, observation date or range, and source-specific status semantics.
retention: Retain immutable registry releases under the most restrictive contributing artifact policy; corrections publish a later release rather than modifying a published release.
redistribution: Local review only. No public redistribution is authorized by this derived policy; each exported field must independently satisfy its upstream policy.
personal_data_handling: Minimize personal data, preserve source-level access restrictions, and do not infer sensitive facts or services from names, addresses, licenses, or category codes.
